about:
Champion Plastics, based in Clifton, New Jersey, has been producing polyethylene packaging since 1972. The company operates an 18-acre manufacturing campus that includes one of the industry's largest resin storage silos, with a capacity of 2,000 tons.

The company manufactures a broad line of polyethylene bags, liners, covers, films, sheeting, tubing, and shrink packaging. Its capabilities include custom sizes, gauges, and configurations, with gauge ranges from 0.0005 to 0.010 mil, and options for additives such as EVA, UV inhibitors, anti-static, and flame retardant. The facility supports printing up to 10 colors and various packaging formats.

Champion Plastics serves a wide range of industries, including pharmaceutical, food processing, chemical, industrial manufacturing, medical waste, and retail. Its customer base includes Fortune 500 companies across sectors such as aerospace, automotive, agriculture, construction, and textiles.

The company emphasizes its broad product selection, competitive pricing, responsive service, and dependable delivery as key differentiators. It maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification to ensure consistent quality and traceability.
